bio: If you want to combine a hiking trip with a really wonderful meal at a fair price, the Grafl family establishment is the place to go! In this typical regional inn in a wonderfully idyllic location, the cuisine is traditional, aromatic, and perfectly crafted. The Pressknödelsuppe (dumpling soup) and Almrindsülzchen (Alpine beef aspic) are full of flavour, not to mention classics such as beef goulash and schnitzel. In summer, the terrace boasting a view of the surrounding countryside and mountains is a joy. Overnight accommodation is also an option....
